run_hw_manual_test: run the manual hardware test script to verify Stretch robot head, navigation, and manipulation
test_stretch_client_reset: test the StretchClient reset method to return the robot to its initial state
test_head_movement: test the robot head look_at_ee and look_front methods for head movement control
test_navigation: test the robot navigation navigate_to method to move the base to a target xyt pose
test_manipulation: test the robot manipulation goto_ee_pose method to move the end effector by a relative offset
